columns.name: team_api_id
columns.description: The unique identifier for the team.

columns.name: team_long_name
columns.description: The long name of the team.

columns.name: team_short_name
columns.description: The short name of the team.

columns.name: num_lost_matches_as_home_team_2016
columns.description: The number of matches the team lost as the home team in the 2015/2016 season, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: less_than_avg_chance_creation_passing_2014
columns.description: Set to 1 if the team had less than the average chance creation passing in 2014, otherwise, set to 0.

columns.name: avg_num_goals_as_away_team
columns.description: The average number of goals the team scored as the away team.

columns.name: num_won_2010
columns.description: The number of matches the team won in the 2009/2010 season, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: num_goals
columns.description: The total number of goals the team scored, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: player_api_id
columns.description: The unique identifier for the player.

columns.name: player_name
columns.description: The name of the player.

columns.name: birthday
columns.description: The birthday of the player.

columns.name: height_above_180
columns.description: Set to 1 if the player's height is above 180 cm, otherwise, set to 0.

columns.name: avg_penalties_rate
columns.description: The average rate of penalties the player scores.

columns.name: average_overall_rating_from_2010_to_2015
columns.description: The average overall rating the player received from 2010 to 2015.

columns.name: is_under_180_and_overall_rating_more_than_70
columns.description: Set to 1 if the player's height is under 180 cm and the overall rating is more than 70 in at least one season; otherwise, set to 0.

columns.name: avg_finishing_rate
columns.description: The average rate of finishing the player has.

columns.name: league_id
columns.description: The unique identifier for the league.

columns.name: country_name
columns.description: The name of the country the league is in.

columns.name: league_name
columns.description: The name of the league.

columns.name: num_goals_2016
columns.description: The total number of goals scored of the league in the 2015/2016 season, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: away_team_won_most_2010
columns.description: The team with the most wins as an away team during the 2009/2010 season, with ties broken by the ascending order of the team's long name

columns.name: num_draw_matches_2016
columns.description: The number of matches that ended in a draw in the 2015/2016 season, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: avg_goal_by_home_team_higher_than_away_team
columns.description: Set to 1 if the average goal scored by the home team is higher than the away team, otherwise, set to 0.

columns.name: num_matches_2008_2009_season
columns.description: The number of matches played of the league in the 2008/2009 season, replace NULL values with 0.
